_comment: Site-wide config, compiled into the bundle at build time. n8n_base is the host that serves the five quiz endpoints (/lead /slots /book /lead/skip /beacon) under api_prefix. Empty pixel_id keeps the Meta Pixel inert. Empty turnstile_sitekey keeps the Turnstile slot inert.

company.status: Private company, registered in South Africa

_footer_comment: FOOTER-v3 (spec FOOTER-DISCLOSURE-SPEC-SMC-2026-10-21 section 2): footer_line is the no-advice line on every footer. company.footer_identity=true appends 'It is a trading name of <legal_name>.' (recommended, not required; off by Jono's decision, 21 Oct 2026). The old FOOTER-v2 text lives on /legal/ as disclosure_statement.
footer_line: SortMyCover is not a financial services provider and gives no financial advice.
disclosure_statement: SortMyCover is a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd. We introduce you to authorised financial services providers. We are not a financial services provider. We do not give financial advice, compare products or quote premiums. You must be 18 or older.

will_provider._comment: Public wills lines only (Jono, 18 Oct 2026: the provider is not named on the site). Identity: config/will-provider.internal.json.
will_provider.service_line: Your will call is with a will consultant. Lindi sends the consultant's name and firm, with its FSP number, on WhatsApp before the call.
will_provider.role_line: SortMyCover does not draft wills and gives no advice. It puts you in touch with a will consultant.
